'''Aiteff''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] serving with the [[Sunesi]] resistance on [[Monor II]]. Aiteff helped to break [[Daye Azur-Jamin]] break out of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] incarceration.
